subject: Convert intro demo into architectural workshop — alignment & scheduling
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@nebula-analytics.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@nebula-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Converting intro demo into an architectural workshop?

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. After circling with the team, our CTO would like to change the session: instead of a high-level product demo, we'd prefer an architectural deep dive / workshop so our infra and ML engineering teams can evaluate integration points.

A couple constraints: our CTO (Maya) will be traveling Aug 26–30 and there will be a couple of network/security folks who need to attend. Ideally we do a 90–120 minute workshop the week of Aug 23 or the first week of September. Can you support moving to that format? We also have a short set of prework items we can share if that helps you scope the agenda.

High-level asks from our side:
- Walk us through runtime, quantization/latency tradeoffs for our workload
- Network and VPC connectivity checklist
- Example integration pattern for embeddings + reranking

Attendees from our side: Elena Park (Program Lead), Samir Khan (Network Lead), Maya Li (CTO, may be remote depending on travel).

Thanks — if you can propose a couple of slots and an outline, we can confirm quickly.

Best,
Elena
Elena Park
Program Lead, Nebula Analytics
elena.park@nebula-analytics.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@nebula-analytics.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Converting intro demo into an architectural workshop?

Elena — thanks for the note and the clear asks. We can definitely convert this into an architectural workshop and tailor it to the network/VPC and latency tradeoffs you mentioned.

Proposal:
- Format: 120-minute interactive workshop (slides + live inference walkthrough + breakout Q&A)
- Core focuses: serving runtime architecture, quantization options, VPC/network checklist, integration examples for embeddings/reranking
- Deliverables: short prework checklist for you to fill out, an agenda, and a small ops checklist we can run 48 hours before the workshop

Two slot options from our side (your timezone PDT):
1) Tue, Aug 24, 11:00–13:00 PDT — short turnaround but possible if your team can prep
2) Thu, Sep 3, 09:00–11:00 PDT — cleaner given Maya's travel window

I attached a draft agenda for the workshop (architectural-workshop-agenda.pdf) — can you review and flag additions?

Alex — can you bring a runtime specialist and be prepared to demo a short live call showing prefix caching and quantized model tradeoffs?

Elena — once you confirm a slot I will send a calendar invite and include a prework checklist.

Thanks,

— Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
pri﻿yom.das@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: architectural-workshop-agenda.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@nebula-analytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Converting intro demo into an architectural workshop?

Priyom — I can cover the runtime demo. Prefer the Sept 3 slot given the team's bandwidth; Aug 24 is tight for us.

Couple of asks from engineering side:
- Can Nebula share a short inference workload summary (token lengths, avg seq length, peak qps) and one or two representative prompts? That will let me pre-compile a short test and show latency/cost tradeoffs for quantized variants.
- We'll also include a security engineer (Marissa) for the VPC/NAT/firewall discussion — Marissa, are you available Sept 3?

If we get those artifacts by Aug 27 we can run a quick dry-run the week before.

— Alex
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com
From: Elena Park <elena.park@nebula-analytics.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@nebula-analytics.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Converting intro demo into an architectural workshop?

Thanks — Sept 3 works for us, please pencil that in. I've attached our prework workbook (nebula-poc-prework.xlsx) — it has a short section for workload stats and a network contact for Samir to fill in connectivity details.

Samir — can you confirm whether you want us to run a network checklist ahead of the workshop (e.g., allowlist IPs, open ports for our test harness)?

We prefer 09:00–11:00 PDT Sept 3. Please include calendar invite, dial-in link and a short note on any ports/hosts we need to open in advance.

Thanks,
Elena

Attachments: nebula-poc-prework.xlsx (Excel, 2 sheets)
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2026 09:25:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Architectural workshop — Thu Sep 3, 09:00–11:00 PDT

Elena — confirmed for Thu, Sep 3, 09:00–11:00 PDT. I updated the format from an intro demo to a focused architectural workshop per your request. Calendar invite is going out now.

Quick logistics summary (for the invite):
- When: Thu, Sep 3, 09:00–11:00 PDT
- Where: Google Meet (link in invite) + Dial-in in calendar note
- Redwood attendees: Priyom Das (Solutions Lead), Alex Martinez (Runtime SE), Marissa Cole (Security Engineer)
- Nebula attendees: Elena Park (Program Lead), Samir Khan (Network Lead), Maya Li (CTO — tentative depending on travel)
- Prework requested: fill nebula-poc-prework.xlsx (workload stats + network details) by Aug 27 so we can run a dry-run
- Attachments included in calendar invite: architectural-workshop-agenda.pdf, nebula-poc-prework.xlsx

Related links: HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/NEB-3571

If Samir wants a short network checklist, we can run a 20-minute connectivity quick-check on Tue, Sep 1 — let me know and I'll add it as a separate invite.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to it.

— Priyom
